record.content: The max_chars recall budget in Remind drops whole low-ranked concepts or episodes, one at a time from the weaker tail, until the rendered output fits — it never truncates mid-item. Rationale: a half-rendered concept is worse than a missing one because the agent cannot tell it is incomplete. Implemented in MemoryInterface._format_with_char_budget, which re-renders after each pop and compares the trailing concept activation against the trailing episode score to decide which list to shorten.
